intent: A character-led costume material study of an original 34-year-old woman who hosts important negotiations: composed, socially assured and subtly theatrical. Express fine wardrobe construction with an intentionally fluid outer layer and a more structured opaque core.

subjects.description: Original adult woman with individual softly angular features, assured gaze and a naturally curvy proportionate figure; dark hair in a low asymmetric coil held by two tiny ivory floral pins, small silver drop earrings.
appearance: An opaque muted coral silk-satin fitted dress with a softly squared neckline and supportive princess-seamed bodice, a natural waist and an overlapping long skirt. A pale orchid organza open over-robe adds airy sleeve volume, secured with two small shaped silver clasps at the upper side panels.

The coral core has a fine tone-on-tone woven flowing-line pattern over its main panels, visible in raking light and coherent through folds. Pale orchid organza is sheer only on the sleeves and side drapes: single layers reveal the underlying arm or dress, overlaps deepen toward lilac, folded hems are visibly denser.

A sparse original fine embroidery meander travels over selected outer-sleeve fields, changing with the fabric plane, with a few raised stitches near a functional fastening. The silver clasps remain crisp small solid objects, the satin shows a broad soft directional highlight, and the organza has thin floating edges. Keep skin natural and the dress fully opaque.
subjects.action: She turns gently toward an arriving guest with one hand resting on the back of a chair, the other lifting a small fold of the outer sleeve clear of the seat.

scene.summary: Knee-up three-quarter view at eye level, in a quiet guesthouse room with warm window light and a muted gray-beige background. Show the material overlap on the near arm and torso clearly; face, near garment and waist in readable focus, composed human presence rather than a glamour pose.
